headline: Why Tutor Perini (TPC) Is Up 18.3% After Dividend Hike, Buybacks And New Federal Contract
summary: Tutor Perini recently reported past second-quarter 2026 results showing sales of US$1,637.05 million and net income of US$65.74 million, alongside a 50% increase in its quarterly dividend to US$0.09 per share and completion of a US$29.99 million share repurchase program covering 414,952 shares. These results, together with a new US$69.5 million Death Valley National Park infrastructure contract that will enter backlog in the third quarter of 2026, highlight how Tutor Perini is pairing higher...
